paper.title_en: Universal Leading Quantum Stress Near the Schwarzschild Singularity
paper.abstract_en: Determining the local quantum source near a spacelike singularity is essential for assessing semiclassical backreaction inside black holes. By standard point splitting, we provide, to our knowledge, the first complete numerical determination of the renormalized stress-energy tensor (RSET) of a massless scalar field at arbitrary curvature coupling in the four-dimensional Schwarzschild interior. Calculations in the Unruh and Hartle--Hawking states reach $r/M\simeq10^{-4}$, yielding a common leading $r^{-6}$ coefficient tensor and coupling-dependent anisotropic pressure ratios. Uniform estimates of the complete mode sums then establish a rigidity theorem: at each fixed coupling, any Hadamard-state change on the common interior evolution domain contributes only subleading stress. The leading tensor is therefore insensitive to time and directional dependence of the quantum environment, in contrast with state-dependent leading Cauchy-horizon coefficients in asymptotically flat Reissner--Nordström spacetime. Its directional null projections define positive, mixed-sign, and negative regimes in coupling and direction, specifying the local mean focusing source; at conformal coupling, all leading projections are positive.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在四维Schwarzschild黑洞内部首次完整数值确定无质量标量场在任意曲率耦合下的重整化应力-能量张量，给出领先r^{-6}系数张量与耦合依赖的各向异性压力比，并建立刚性定理，表明Hadamard态变化仅贡献次领先应力。主题属于广义相对论基础（黑洞内部半经典反作用与奇点物理），理论深度与数值方法严谨性均较高，结果具有方向性与耦合依赖的新颖结构，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: Schwarzschild奇点附近普适的领先量子应力
decision.abstract_zh: 确定类空奇点附近的局部量子源，对于评估黑洞内部的半经典反作用至关重要。通过标准的点分离方法，我们据我们所知首次完整数值确定了四维Schwarzschild内部无质量标量场在任意曲率耦合下的重整化应力-能量张量（RSET）。在Unruh态和Hartle--Hawking态中的计算达到$r/M\simeq10^{-4}$，得到了共同的领先$r^{-6}$系数张量以及耦合依赖的各向异性压力比。随后对完整模式和的均匀估计建立了一个刚性定理：在每个固定耦合下，共同内部演化域上的任何Hadamard态变化仅贡献次领先应力。因此，领先张量对量子环境的时间依赖和方向依赖不敏感，这与渐近平坦Reissner--Nordström时空中依赖状态的领先Cauchy视界系数形成对比。其方向零投影在耦合和方向中定义了正、混合符号和负区域，指定了局部平均聚焦源；在共形耦合下，所有领先投影均为正。
